summary: The root expresses dread or dismay. In Genesis 9:2 its noun חַת describes the dread that creatures feel toward humans.

senses.definition: The fear that someone inspires in another.

evidence.note: The dread of Noah and his sons is paired with the fear of them. Both are said to come upon the animals.

parallels.note: Fear and dread have the same object and are experienced by the same creatures.
